title: Confinement effects on molecular diffusion in zeolites: mechanisms and perspectives
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00613A, Review Article
Lei Zhao, Jiamin Yuan, Youdong Xing, Ji Qi, Peng Peng, Zhiqiang Liu, Anmin Zheng
This review provides a comprehensive elucidation of the fundamental mechanisms and key interactions governing molecular diffusion under nanoconfinement in zeolites.
